quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end. Traffic in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways when crossing the intersection.
You must come to a full stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means people may be walking across the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a bicycle crossing. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Drive carefully where pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow car if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This yellow sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid brake problems or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. When conditions are bad, you should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will curve right. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep going at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What is the order of traffic light colors from bottom to top?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully, but you do not have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass safely. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of an overpass ahead. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height listed (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering. They warn drivers about hazards and special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter from your current direction because traffic flows one way only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to people crossing in a crosswalk. Pay attention to pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet, and your vehicle may be hard to control.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is not allowed. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No trucks allowed on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It shows a law that drivers must follow. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn of unusual or dangerous conditions near work areas. This sign alerts you to road maintenance ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign means a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing ahead. The road slopes steeply down to the tracks. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic must go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic must go in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic can move.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They show rules drivers must follow. This sign tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about hazards ahead. This sign means a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign tell you?

options.text: The safe speed limit for residential areas.
The safe speed limit for highway exits.
The safe speed limit for highway entrances.
The safe speed limit for work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for highway exits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for a highway exit. For example, it may say 30 mph.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room for them. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them enter safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the bridge ahead is narrow. You may not have room to pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you should stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops when mechanical turn signals are not available. A left arm extended straight to the left means the rider is turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital emergency room is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet, so you should drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means you must stop. You must yield the right-of-way at the intersection. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed allowed on that road. During rain, snow, ice, or bad weather, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way roads separated by a divider. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and other traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider:
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider is about to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down when approaching an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a T-intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down, check for traffic, and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of or along with turn signals. Bend your left arm at the elbow and point it upward to signal a right turn or right lane change.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to go the wrong way on a one-way street.
You can go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to go the wrong way on a one-way street.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. When this sign is posted, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals to show turns or stops instead of or along with turn signals. Extend your left arm straight out to signal a left turn or left lane change.

questions.question: What type of road condition does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane will exit the freeway. You can change lanes to stay on the highway, or you must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What is the main danger when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom for vertical traffic lights. For horizontal lights, red is on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or make U-turns.
